disclosure: FILED AFTER THE WORK, NOT BEFORE IT, AND SAYING SO RATHER THAN BACKDATING A TIMESTAMP. This session read the dispatch, oriented, built, and only then was handed the sibling lane's close out of which the gate below was read. So what follows is not a pre-registered prediction: each item carries the measurement that produced it, and the falsifiers in `preRegisteredFalsifiers` are reported as results rather than as a bet placed in advance. The failure this disclosure prevents is a checkpoint that reads like foreknowledge it did not have. It follows the convention g156 and g153-fleet-police-lens established for the same situation.

premisesReverified.premise: An instrument that scans artboards cannot reach the built surface on its own.
premisesReverified.verified: Read at source in both check.mjs: the readers are anchored on the artboards' INLINE STYLE signatures (e.g. `border-radius:var(--sc-r-pill); padding:2px 6px; white-space:nowrap;`), which the product's stylesheets do not emit. Pointed at built markup they would match ZERO and the verdict would be vacuous-but-green, which is the exact defect class these instruments open with.

preRegisteredFalsifiers: F1 - A check that passes on zero matched inputs has proved nothing. Violation: both instruments print their matched-input counts and refuse the verdict if any predicate matched zero. Measured after the --dir bridge: public-works pairs=18 badges=28 cells=154 numbers=185 cipIds=10 queueRefs=11 statuses=4 verbatim 8/8; fire-ems pairs=9 badges=21 chips=24 cells=102 numbers=119 faIds=12 stnRefs=18 verbatim 5/5. Neither refuses.

F2 - The four matrix states must be four distinct marks and no cell may be drawn as two of them. Violation: src/public-works-matrix.test.mjs asserts every state cell carries EXACTLY one state hook, requires the fixture to cover all four, and requires an unresolved pack to draw unmeasured+cannot-occur and NEVER a counted zero.

F3 - The instrument must be shown able to FAIL, in both directions, for both lenses. Violation: 14 planted violations, 14 refused (money on Public works, an invented badge word, a person in a cell, a wrong domain/gate pair, a roster out of composer order, a fifth readiness band), each planted into a COPY so the real surfaces are untouched.

F4 - No retry affordance may exist on a blocked board. Violation: retry=0, try-again=0, refresh=0, contact-support=0 counted on both blocked surfaces, and the only <button> elements are the region tab switchers the two-regions-that-switch requirement needs.

F5 - A merge ships nothing, so reachability must not be inferred from the PR. Violation: the deployed apps were probed and the branch's routes are 404 on both, so the clause is named as needing a deploy rather than reported as reached.
leave_behind: THE DO-APP CLAUSE NEEDS A DEPLOY AND THIS LANE WAS NOT THE DEPLOYER. Both apps serve 7487d7c; PR #76 is unmerged and deploy_on_push is unset. /lens/public-works, /lens/fire-ems and /api/lenses/*/dashboard are 404 on both apps as measured.

THE CLIENT-SIDE PAINTER IS THE FOLLOW-UP. src/server.mjs serves both lens bodies fully rendered, and the payloads are exposed as JSON, but web/app.js does not yet paint these two bodies, so web/index.html still bakes the previous sections. Wiring the painters is a deliberate non-goal of this lane rather than an oversight: a painter that silently renders nothing is worse than a served page, and the served page is the surface the checks could actually be pointed at.

THIS LANE IS NOT THE OWNER OF THE 102-OF-102 LIVE-RECORD REFUSAL. It belongs to g153-fleet-police-lens and is now the next unit of work (the vendor mapping). Nothing here waits on it and nothing here worsens it.
